text:
Maya: Heads-up — we need to decide how Console surfaces SLO alert sensitivity. PM asked for a 'slider' + preview, but we need to align on semantics w/ routing and notify tiers. Thoughts? :thinking:

Raj: I'd prefer 3 discrete buckets (low/normal/high). Slider makes UX ambiguous. low=aggressive noise suppression, high=more noisy but misses fewer regressions.

Jordan: agree on 3 buckets. Also need a 'preview' mode that shows which historical alerts would have fired given current sensitivity so users can tune.

Maya: Exactly. PM wants preview. Should we run preview by replaying recent windows in analytics job or approximate via query? Replaying may be expensive.

OpsBot: analytics-replay job queued: job id 8712. ETA ~30m (automated)

Chris: For API surface, propose adding to SLO policy schema: "alert_sensitivity": "low|medium|high" and "notify_preview": true/false. Example PATCH payload:
```json
{ "alert_sensitivity": "low", "notify_preview": true }
```

Elena: Two concerns: 1) mapping sensitivity to notify routing (who gets paged) — we should not change on-call fanout unless tenant explicitly opts in. 2) Make default "medium" and expose cost/false-positive estimate.

Raj: Agreed on default medium. For routing we can keep escalation unchanged but mark preview alerts as 'informational' to the UI and audit log, not PagerDuty.

Maya: Implementation notes: console toggle + dropdown. Backend: SLO policy + preview endpoint that returns sample alerts with counts. UX: show chart of suppression vs sensitivity and a table: would-have-fired alerts.

Jordan: Also add an API param ?include_preview=true to GET /slo-policies/:id so SDKs can render same view without separate endpoint.

Chris: Minor infra ask — need a new telemetry metric slo.alert_preview_runs and cost tag. Elena can you own estimating cost impact?

Elena: Can pick up. Quick estimate: replay for 30 days for a mid tenant ~ 10-12s cores, but we can do sampled replay and windowed aggregation to reduce cost.

Maya: Cool. Plan: implement backend schema + preview endpoint (Raj + Chris), console UX (Maya + Jordan), cost estimate (Elena). I'll make a GH issue and link when I have it. :thumbsup:

Raj: I'll spike mapping table from sensitivity->heuristics and share by EOD.

OpsBot: linked issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4321

Maya: thanks all.
